readerCopy.body: Something that once created doubt can become useful experience instead of the main reason to hold back. When Jupiter trines Chiron, expansion and sensitivity reinforce each other, making difficult history relevant to teaching, applying, leading, trying again, or taking on a larger role. Earlier setbacks do not have to be called beneficial in order for the knowledge gained through them to matter. Growth can use the lesson without romanticizing the cost.
